title: General Manager Suriname
description:
General Manager - Suriname

Job Purpose:

We are a global leader in the Transportation and Logistics industry, aiming to strengthen our presence in the Caribbean Islands. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced General Manager to lead our operations in Suriname. The Branch Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of our business operations, driving strategic initiatives, and ensuring the achievement of company goals. This role requires a visionary leader with a strong track record of success in managing diverse teams and delivering exceptional results.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to the organization in one of the five countries named.
  • Develop and implement and drive business strategies to achieve company objectives and growth targets.
  • Oversee daily operations, including sales, logistics, customer care finance, and human resources.
  • Foster a positive and inclusive company culture that promotes employee engagement and development.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and regulatory bodies.
  • Monitor industry trends and market conditions to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.
  • Ensure compliance with local laws and regulations.
  • Prepare and present regular reports to senior management on business performance and strategic initiatives.

Key Competencies:

  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Results-driven with a proven ability to achieve business goals.
  • High level of integrity and professionalism.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Proficiency in financial management and budgeting.


Qualifications / Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Business Administration, Management, Logistics or a related field (MBA preferred).
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in a senior management role, preferably within the Shipping, Transport or Logistics industries.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully managing relations with local authorities.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and growing a business.
  • Fluency in Dutch and English is necessary for this role.
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong understanding of the local market, regulations and business environment.
  • Suitable combination of the above will be considered.


If you are a visionary leader with a passion for driving business success, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
